review_kind: Claude AI translation and review (Claude Opus 5.5) on 2026-11-11 of the strings added on the lane-q-1111 branch against the exact English source: the label and tooltip of ops_prefix_quality_method (item 920's choice between spaCR's read-count cell classes and the pooled Cell Painting recipe's 'simple' classes PERISCOPE used). No native-speaker sign-off.

records.source: How each cell's quality class is set from its matched reads. 'spacr' counts reads: perfect needs ops_quality_min_reads exact reads of one barcode, and a tie between barcodes is ambiguous. 'recipe_simple' uses the 'simple' rules of the Broad pooled Cell Painting recipe that PERISCOPE used: one barcode with only exact reads is perfect, one barcode with a corrected read is great, and several barcodes are imperfect or bad; ops_quality_min_reads is then not used. Default 'spacr'. Alpha.
records.translation: Hvernig gæðaflokkur hverrar frumu er ákvarðaður út frá pöruðum lestrum hennar. 'spacr' telur lestra: perfect þarf ops_quality_min_reads nákvæma lestra eins strikamerkis, og jafntefli milli strikamerkja er ambiguous. 'recipe_simple' notar 'simple'-reglur Broad-uppskriftarinnar fyrir sameinað Cell Painting sem PERISCOPE notaði: eitt strikamerki með aðeins nákvæmum lestrum er perfect, eitt strikamerki með leiðréttum lestri er great, og mörg strikamerki eru imperfect eða bad; ops_quality_min_reads er þá ekki notað. Sjálfgefið 'spacr'. Alfa.
